response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced generalist engineer (15+ years) with staff-level titles, strong TypeScript/Node.js depth, testing/craftsmanship rigor, and recent exposure to MCP code generators and agentic workflow tooling at re:cinq — which maps to one niche requirement of this role. However, the resume shows essentially no production GenAI delivery: no Python in the skills list, no RAG or vector database work, no LLM evaluation/observability pipelines, no multi-agent frameworks, and limited large-scale cloud AI architecture (AWS CDK for a pricing platform is the closest). The role requires 8+ years shipping production AI solutions, and the demonstrable AI experience here is roughly one year and infrastructure-adjacent. Also no evidence of customer-facing consulting or discovery leadership. Worth a screening call only if the team values a strong engineering foundation plus MCP familiarity over direct GenAI depth.
strengths: Hands-on MCP and agentic-workflow tooling experience at re:cinq
15+ years shipping production systems; strong TypeScript/Node.js and testing discipline
Proven mentoring and technical leadership via workshops, talks, and OSS projects
concerns: No demonstrated production GenAI, RAG, or vector database experience
Python not listed among skills despite being a core requirement
Little evidence of customer-facing discovery or enterprise consulting work

key_factors.factor: Deep senior/staff engineering and delivery track record
